items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So I said, Pete would be great for it, so I wrote -- so we did it, so he was pleased... I called Gene Wright... I got him and drummer and we opened in the Sands.

ctx.x: So I said, Pete would be great for it, so I wrote -- so we did it, so he was pleased and then he said what're you doing about Vegas, this year? I said, Gee, I don't know, I was supposed to go back in for Monte. He said, Well, I'm going in the Sands beginning in February, said call Monte.

So I called Monte, I said, 'You made any plans for me?' He said, 'See Red, I forgot, I haven't done it at all,' I said, 'Well, I got a chance to go another place,' I said for a month or two. He said, 'Go ahead.' So I said to Frank, 'I hate to do it with a trio, it's too hard in the lounges,' so he said, 'All right, add a couple of men.' So, I called Gene Wright, I said, 'Do you know anybody that's a cookin' anyplace I could (unintelligible) little saxophone player that plays good? He said, 'Yeah, I know, Jerry…
